name: bkk-shophouse-forms
note: Slim render set: only candidates that carry a real Overture storey count. The full 2,273-candidate set stays at /bkk-shophouse-candidates.geojson as a download; the 1,512 without a storey count are never drawn and are not shipped to the browser.
disclaimer: These are morphology-detected row candidates, not a heritage survey. Every feature is review_status="unverified candidate". Heights come from storey counts (modal-storeys or overture-storeys), not measurement. Render them as plausible shophouse fabric, never as documented heritage, and never as evidence for demolition, protection or value.
